name: Sengo to Zatsuon.
source:
After the war, you were assigned to monitor someone to help suppress his PTSD. Fulfill your duty as a monitor by working as a housekeeper for the veteran/your former superior officer, Colonel Fabio.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13414]Novelgame[/url]]
